name: arxiv-mcp-server
description: Search arXiv, fetch paper metadata, and read full-text content via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search arXiv, fetch paper metadata, and read full-text content via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Search the arXiv academic paper corpus. Supports full-text search, paper metadata retrieval by ID, full-text reading (HTML render, or text extracted from the PDF when none exists), and category taxonomy listing. Deployable as stdio or streamable HTTP.
